| 23:00 | 299 | 215 | 1,660 | 3,381 |

**Query used:**
```
panda clickhouse query-raw clickhouse-refined "SELECT slot, min(seen_slot_start_diff) as min_arrival_ms, ... FROM mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node FINAL WHERE slot_start_date_time >= '2026-06-20 00:00:00' AND slot_start_date_time < '2026-06-21 00:00:00' GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot ASC"
```

The data comes from `xatu-cbt` → `clickhouse-refined` → `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`. The `seen_slot_start_diff` column measures milliseconds from slot start to when each node first observed the block.

history.commit_message: Point README link to ethpandaops.io Panda blog post (#227)
fix(docker): copy datasets/ into the build stage (#226)
Extract proxy auth into a token.Source abstraction (#228)
fix(docker): run server as root under rootless Docker to read credentials (#225)
Gate server readiness on initial datasource discovery (#224)
fix(auth): request configured scopes in device authorization flow (#231)
feat(proxy): versioned /v2/embedding route + server v2 client (#232)
feat(search): re-index on proxy embedding model change (#233)
fix(auth): coordinate credential refresh across processes and guard logins (#235)
test(eval): fix grader false-negatives on chart-URL and late-column cases (#238)
ci(release): build and push sandbox image before goreleaser (#236)
fix(docker): run server as the credentials owner for non-1000 host UIDs (#241)
feat(sandbox): add chartkit charting library (#246)
feat(storage): scope uploads by session and return host path (#248)
fix: It should use chartkits for the actual charting? (#249)
fix(chartkit): harden against visually-broken charts; require network + structured source (#251)
feat(networks): devnet data + notes.ethereum.org specs in CLI and Python (#250)
docs(storage): surface host_path and session reuse in getting-started + CLI footer (#253)
feat(evm): EVM execution module — opcode trial, tracing, tx submission against devnet nodes (#252)
search: replace inline content with ref URIs + panda read command (#255)
fix(search): activate semantic search on proxy discovery, not only at startup (#260)
feat(resources): resolve the right resource path on a read miss (#261)
feat(compute): add compute datasource for ephemeral sandboxes (#265)
feat(proxy): forward caller token to compute backend (#268)
feat(compute): human-readable default output + list filtering (#267)
feat(compute): add snapshots promote command (#271)
fix(cli): datasource-aware error hints to reduce avoidable CLI errors (#130)
feat(runbooks): add devnet consensus bug report runbook (#273)
Rebuild runbook registry with hybrid retrieval; hard cutover to task-typed embedding (#274)
docs(runbooks): fix accuracy, contract, and retrieval issues from live testing (#278)
